title: Software Engineer
description: Owned the system management, monitoring, and data-processing components of WxConnect, a direct-receive environmental satellite system deployed across 10 customer sites. Built the distributed services and space-packet assembly pipeline needed to control the system and process a 31 Mbps real-time stream producing approximately 1.8 TB of data per day, establishing capabilities that later evolved into the GWSAS project.
highlights: Owned the management and monitoring component that reported system status and exposed centralized operational controls.
Used Flask and RabbitMQ to connect distributed elements to a unified monitoring and control dashboard, and automated deployments and configuration with Ansible, Bash, and YAML.
Owned the codebase that assembled incoming space packets from two 15.5 Mbps streams into a 31 Mbps processing pipeline.
Processed approximately 1.8 TB of satellite data per day across 10 sites for a government customer.
Implemented GOES and Himawari data-recovery workflows that produced netCDF files and helped establish the processing foundation for the later GWSAS project.
